title: key_expires field is write-only state; no record/key GC beyond read-time pruning
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py:231,271 zero consumers found. Grace expiry checked on reads (correct) but dead field invites false assumption. Remove or implement GC semantics.
close_reason: Premise stale after today's rework (commit 9a857b8ce3 + working tree): key_expires is NO LONGER write-only - groups_collection.py:570 consumes it, serving it as 'expires' in the live GET /groups/{id}/key metadata response. Deletion branch would regress a working endpoint to expires=None for zero benefit; GC branch is overkill: retired-key grace already prunes via per-entry expires (_live_retired), group deletion is explicit owner DELETE, and nothing keys a lifecycle off key_expires. Chose simplest correct option: keep the field and pin its sole consumer evidentially - added additive test_key_metadata_reports_advertised_key_expiry in test_groups_item.py asserting full hand-derived payloads (expires=t0+86400 at create; t0+100+86400 after rekey; algorithm/key_id exact; no secret/salt leak). grep confirms exactly 3 occurrences repo-wide (2 writes, 1 read).
